_note: The compiler deletes TypeScript-only nodes (import type, import { type x }, declare const/let/class/function, declare fields, abstract methods) before building scopes, so a type-only `state` import or a `declare const state` does not turn `$state` into a store subscription (no store_rune_conflict). The TS1184 on `declare` inside the component body is what upstream svelte-check reports too.
